requirements.text: Ordinary parsing, totals, checkpoint and error preservation.
Tenant-scoped duplicate identity, conflict rejection and compatible saved state.
Durable event recovery across post-commit/pre-ack interruption without loss or double-application.

coverage_limits: Signed64 aggregate overflow is retained as a requirement but not dynamically measured: a public-API-only setup with signed32 events needs more than four billion records. Existing guards in the recorded patches were inspected; this is not an execution result. No full-contract certification is claimed.
